page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-192-standardlssd is a high-capacity virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 1512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. While the local storage size is specified as None in the configuration payload, the platform utilizes NVMe SSD storage technology. This instance does not include any GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to the dedicated CPU allocation and substantial memory capacity, this server is designed for resource-intensive workloads requiring high memory density. No benchmark data is available to evaluate its raw processing or memory bandwidth performance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated vCPUs and memory resources positions this instance in a premium hardware class, making it suitable for enterprise-scale deployments where resource consolidation outweighs the cost of smaller, distributed nodes.

The z4d-highmem-192-standardlssd is engineered for memory-intensive and large-scale database workloads. Appropriate use cases include in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, heavy data warehousing, and complex analytics pipelines that require massive memory footprints alongside high-count parallel processing capabilities.
